name: Funny UFOs Scene Creator
summary:
Make "funny" scenes starring the cast of the Funny UFOs series! Featuring iconic characters like Biggo Blast, Baby Birdungo, The Squink, and more across 8 different worlds to explore. Right click characters to turn them around. Right click on objects to make extra copies.

I've always loved the scene creator genre, and it was awesome getting to create my own. Maybe more to come?
